coordination_delta: After discovering PR #156, duplicate ACK/reentry work was abandoned. This candidate retains only incremental work ownership, fencing, stale-spec and durable effect-intent protections.
hypothesis: PR #156 causal worker re-entry plus one-active-work lease/fencing and durable reserve-before-effect reduces duplicate/stale execution under retry, crash and failover.
counterhypothesis: PR #156 plus mandatory live refresh/revalidation is sufficient and lease/effect-intent state adds coordination or SQLite cost without material incremental benefit.
synthetic_warning: These values are assumption-bound simulation outputs, not production measurements. Zero duplicate/stale outcomes follow from modeled fail-closed/idempotent laws and must be falsified on real execution.

bug_found_during_recursive_cycle.old_failure: A post-effect idempotent receipt alone leaves a crash window: the external effect may succeed and the worker may die before the receipt is durable, allowing a retry to repeat the effect.
bug_found_during_recursive_cycle.repair: Persist an effect intent as RESERVED before the consequential external operation. Finalize only after outcome verification. A replay/restart that finds the same still-RESERVED effect key returns RECOVERY_REQUIRED and cannot automatically repeat the effect.
bug_found_during_recursive_cycle.remaining_uncertainty: RESERVED does not prove whether the external operation ran. Recovery must reconcile the real external state or use a provider-side idempotency/transaction key before finalization.
